yufuin.zh: 美食随逛：乳制甜点、布丁、当地牛肉及香橙制品；清酒和麦烧酎也可留意，暂不指定店铺。
yufuin.en: Browse for dairy sweets, pudding, local beef and kabosu products; sake and barley shochu are also ideas. No specific shops selected yet.

yufuin.zh: 乡间骑行是可选活动，目前尚未安排路线或日期。
yufuin.en: Countryside cycling is an optional idea; no route or date has been planned.

yufuin.zh: 住宿倾向选择私人露天温泉；公共浴场的接受程度仍需考虑。
yufuin.en: A private outdoor onsen at the accommodation is preferred; comfort with communal bathing remains a consideration.

beppu-area.zh: 计划从由布院当天往返。把缆车和户外观景优先安排在白天，顺序根据能见度灵活调整。美食可考虑鸡天妇罗、琉球风味腌生鱼片、团子汤及当地海鲜；也可视市场营业时间，买鱼回住宿烹调。偏好私人入浴；砂浴和竹编体验目前仅为想法，尚未选定场所。
beppu-area.en: Planned as a day trip from Yufuin. Prioritize the ropeway and outdoor sightseeing during daylight, with the order kept flexible around visibility. Food ideas include toriten, ryukyu-style marinated sashimi, dangojiru and local seafood. Buying fish to cook at the accommodation is another possibility, subject to market opening times. Private bathing is preferred; sand bathing and bamboo crafts remain ideas without selected venues.

kurokawa.zh: 以轻松的温泉村住宿为主：自由散步、看河畔景色、逛咖啡馆和小吃店。商店与咖啡馆可能较早关门，购物和小吃尽量安排在白天。住宿偏好步行方便、价格合理，并含晚餐和早餐。一处林间或山边景观温泉值得考虑，但公共裸浴会影响选择，私人入浴方式需确认。户外活动安排在白天，离开时给阿苏留足时间。瀑布和平野台均为可选，不必全部打卡。提前确认正餐安排，不依赖晚上临时找餐厅。住宿标价为此前记录的每位成人每晚含两餐、税前起价，并非当前报价或已确认有房。
kurokawa.en: The priority is a relaxed village stay: walking, riverside scenery, cafés and snacks, with time to explore independently. Shops and cafés may close early, so browse and buy snacks during the day. Prefer reasonably priced accommodation within convenient walking distance, ideally with dinner and breakfast included. One scenic forest or mountainside bath may be worthwhile, but communal nudity is a consideration and private options need checking. Use daylight for outdoor activities and leave enough time on departure for Aso. Waterfalls and Hiranodai are optional additions, not a checklist. Confirm meal arrangements rather than relying on finding dinner late in the village. Accommodation prices shown are earlier published starting-rate references per adult per night with two meals, before tax; they are not current quotes or confirmed availability.

aso.zh: 计划从黑川经阿苏观景自驾前往熊本。天气好且只能安排一处主要景点时，优先草千里；时间允许再加大观峰，欣赏盆地全景。已保存的大观峰至草千里道路可达区域路线约 28 公里，模型车程约 30 分钟；规划时建议预留约 40–50 分钟，不含游览、停车及延误，并非实时导航估计。十二月白昼较短，日落大致在下午五点左右；若午饭后才离开黑川，尤其草千里还需 1–2 小时，两处都会较赶。中岳更可能仅开车经过附近景观，不专程参观火口。美食可考虑阿苏赤牛丼，尚未选餐厅。出行前再核实冬季路况和火口开放限制。
aso.en: Planned as a scenic drive from Kurokawa through Aso toward Kumamoto. Kusasenri is the first choice if there is only time for one main stop and the weather is nice; add Daikanbo for the broad caldera panorama if time allows. The saved road route between Daikanbo and the Kusasenri road-access area is about 28 km, with a modelled driving time of about 30 minutes; budget roughly 40–50 minutes for planning, excluding sightseeing, parking and delays. This is an estimate, not live navigation. December daylight is limited, with sunset roughly around 5 p.m.; leaving Kurokawa after lunch makes both stops harder to fit, especially with 1–2 hours at Kusasenri. Nakadake is most likely just a drive through the nearby landscape, not a dedicated crater visit. Akagyu-don, the local red-beef rice bowl, is a food idea without a selected restaurant. Recheck winter road conditions and crater access closer to the visit.
